name: Anekawa Sakura
source:
A jinyou living in Kamizawa city, and a student council member of its academy. Kisaragi Soushichi's underclassman. She has a gentle and friendly character, but the plumpness of her own body results in a complex about it, and for this reason she tries to avoid frequently interacting with the opposite sex.
Her youkai ancestor was a [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tennin]Tennin[/url] (incredibly beautiful, ethereal, celestial women, they are almost always depicted as wearing white, flawless kimono, with scarves wrapped loosely about their bodies), thus she inherited an ability to release a fragrance at will through her mouth, which could put people's heart at peace when inhaled.
Probably due to how she's not very good at dealing with guys in real life, her hobbies are anime, manga and games centering on boy's love. She gets a bit attracted to the new student council member, Kisaragi Soushichi though...
